summary: 'I'm learning ASL' is I LEARN A-S-L, and it's the most useful sentence a beginner can bring into a Deaf space. People are generous with honest learners.
steps: Sign LEARN: a flat non-dominant palm faces up; your dominant hand scoops from it up to your forehead, closing as it rises, like taking knowledge in.
note: Sign this early in any conversation. It sets expectations and signals respect, and most Deaf people will slow down and even teach you signs on the spot.
mistakes: Signing it apologetically. Say it once with a friendly face and then do your best.
